answer: Proof of Stake serves as a primary Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to bond collateral to participate in consensus. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities faces the tide of economic dilution, as acquiring sufficient stake becomes prohibitively expensive. Like the magnetic alignment of ferrous particles, reputation and staked assets consolidate network control. A malicious agent must withstand the zephyr of market volatility to sustain a Sybil attack, making the cost of corruption exceed any potential gain.
